overviewParagraphs: Siam Country Club Old Course is Thai golf's spiritual home — founded in 1971, it is the oldest golf club in the country and carries with it a weight of history and prestige that no other Thai course can claim. Since 2006, it has served as the permanent home of the Honda LPGA Thailand, hosting the world's top women professionals on its classically conditioned parkland layout every season.

The Old Course is a traditional design of great dignity — mature trees line every fairway, the greens are consistently among the best-paced in the region, and the overall playing experience carries an unhurried, club-like atmosphere that the newer resort courses struggle to replicate. It is a course where golf history is tangible.

For discerning golfers who want to walk the same fairways as world-ranked LPGA professionals and connect with the deep roots of Thai golf, Siam Country Club Old Course is an essential experience. AGS includes it regularly on Pattaya and Bangkok-extension golf programs.

curatorBriefHtml: Siam Country Club (Old Course) — originally founded in 1971 as Thailand’s first privately owned golf club and masterfully redesigned by Schmidt-Curley in 2007 — is the historic home of Thai championship golf and the permanent host of the Honda LPGA Thailand. Measuring 6,990 yards (Par 72) in the rolling hills 25 minutes east of Pattaya, the Old Course is celebrated for towering mature trees, over 100 bold sculpted bunkers, and some of the fastest, purest greens in Southeast Asia.

Part of the extraordinary four-course Siam Country Club complex (alongside Plantation, Waterside, and Rolling Hills), the Old Course carries a hushed, Japanese-influenced 5-star club polish — complete with tour-calibrated caddies who read subtle green grain effortlessly and one of Asia’s most refined clubhouses.

Situated just 90 minutes from Bangkok’s Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) and 25 minutes from Pattaya beachfront hotels, Siam Country Club Old Course pairs naturally with Laem Chabang and sister loop Plantation — explore the decision in Siam Country Club: Old Course vs. Plantation.

scorecard.verdict: The spiritual home of tournament golf in Thailand. Host of the Honda LPGA Thailand, the Old Course offers lightning-fast putting surfaces and treacherous bunkers set against pristine floral landscaping.

faqs.q: Why is Siam Country Club Old Course considered Thailand's spiritual home of golf?
faqs.a: Founded in 1971 (redesigned by Schmidt-Curley in 2007), it is Thailand’s oldest private golf club and the permanent annual host of the Honda LPGA Thailand — renowned for lightning-fast greens, mature parkland trees, and tour-grade caddies.

faqs.q: Should we play Siam Country Club Old Course or Plantation Course?
faqs.a: Play the Old Course first for classic, tree-lined LPGA history and fast parkland greens; add Plantation (27 holes) for wider, hillier vistas, triple-green drama, and wind exposure. Many AGS groups play both over two days.

faqs.q: How far is Siam Country Club from Pattaya and Bangkok Airport (BKK)?
faqs.a: Just 25 minutes east of central Pattaya and roughly 90 minutes southeast of Bangkok’s Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) via Motorway 7.

faqs.q: When is the best season to play Siam Country Club (and when is LPGA week)?
faqs.a: November through April is peak dry season in Pattaya. Note that the club closes to visitors around late February each year for the Honda LPGA Thailand — AGS checks tournament dates automatically when planning your itinerary.
